Title: Additional strikes are doing my head in.

Messages.Author: hamd...@my-deja.com
Messages.Body:
With the advent of the !Brujah precon, there has been a spate of
celerity / potence decks cropping up (to my dismay). With celerity
comes additional strikes, and with additional strikes come trouble...

1) Does Jackos additional strike count towards his additional strikes
on the round - i.e. can he still play a Blur after he has had his
additional strike. I think no.

2) Same as the above for Sword of Bloody Judgement. I also think no.

DH

Sent via Deja.com
http://www.deja.com/

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
hamd...@my-deja.com wrote:
> 1) Does Jackos additional strike count towards his additional strikes
> on the round - i.e. can he still play a Blur after he has had his
> additional strike. I think no.

His card text indicates "yes".

> 2) Same as the above for [Sword of Judgment]. I also think no.

Correct, since the rules regarding gaining additional strikes
are not overridden by card text.
